title: Run prep: LinkedIn enrichment, topics and shortlist
description: Speakers and sessions are imported and GitHub profiles are cached (data/cache/github). The Bright Data LinkedIn batch (~170 records), Claude topic extraction and ranking have not run yet. Run `uv run python -m wingman.cli prep`.
acceptance_criteria: `wingman.cli rank` prints a shortlist; spot-check 5 cards for wrong-person matches.

title: Fill in config/me.yaml
description: LinkedIn URL, 2–5 lines about you (role, past employers, schools, topics, hobbies), your goals for GitHub Universe, and known_people (used for 'your friend X worked with them at Y'). Goals are also editable in the app.

title: Ready for GitHub Universe (Oct 28–29)
description: Everything needed to use Wingman at GitHub Universe 2026, Fort Mason, Oct 28–29. Plan: docs/PLAN.md.

title: Fill in API keys in .env
description: WINGMAN_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and BRIGHTDATA_API_KEY are empty in .env. DEEPGRAM_API_KEY (speaker labels) and GITHUB_TOKEN (higher GitHub rate limit, `gh auth token`) are optional. SERP/Unlocker zone names and VAPID push keys are already set. Generate WINGMAN_TOKEN with `openssl rand -hex 24`. Note: README says WINGMAN_TOKEN is already filled in; it isn't.
acceptance_criteria: The three required keys are set and `uv run python -m wingman.cli me` runs.

title: Harden and polish the card and pick screens
description: Run `/impeccable harden` and `/impeccable polish` on the card and pick screens: long names and titles, missing photos, slow or failed scrapes, low-confidence states.

title: Impeccable critique and audit of the phone app
description: Run `/impeccable critique` and `/impeccable audit` on login, capture (badge/QR/note), pick, card, listen, people, recap and settings at iPhone size. File each finding as a bead under this epic.

title: Phone app UX with Impeccable
description: Use the Impeccable skill (.claude/skills/impeccable, `/impeccable <command>`) for all UX work on web/. The app is used one-handed on a loud, bright expo floor, and a card has to read in 5 seconds.

title: Impeccable init: write PRODUCT.md
description: Run `/impeccable init`. Product truth: a single user at a conference; glanceable cards; uncertain matches must never look confirmed; consent prompt before listening; offline last-known shortlist.

title: Dry run with ~20 people you know
description: Plan step 8: run cards for ~20 people you know plus one recorded mock conversation.
acceptance_criteria: No card shown as confirmed for the wrong person; quick card ≤10 s; full card ≤60 s; ≥80% of promises become action items; Bright Data + LLM cost per person within budget.

title: Mic test on iPhone: Wispr Flow vs listen mode
description: iOS usually lets one app use the mic at a time (PLAN.md §2). Start listen, dictate a note with Wispr Flow, and check that listen shows 'Mic unavailable … retrying' and then resumes.

title: Install on iPhone and sign in
description: Open the Fly URL in Safari, Share → Add to Home Screen, open from the home screen, enter WINGMAN_TOKEN, allow notifications. Test one badge photo and one QR code.

title: Copy the prepped graph and cache to the Fly volume
description: After prep, upload data/falkordb/dump.rdb and data/cache to the volume so the server doesn't re-scrape (Bright Data costs).

title: Deploy to Fly.io
description: Script the README steps: fly launch --copy-config --no-deploy, fly volumes create wingman_data --size 1, fly secrets import < .env, fly deploy. An earlier draft of the deploy and data-sync scripts was lost when the disk filled, and it had flagged one fix needed before the first deploy. Re-check fly.toml, Dockerfile and start.sh first.
acceptance_criteria: The app loads over HTTPS on the fly.dev URL and /api/me returns 401 before login.

title: Check the demo scripts
description: `wingman.cli demo maya|reset` plays a scripted conversation into a running server (wingman/demo.py). Run it against `wingman.cli serve` and fix what breaks.

title: Auto-delete transcripts after N days
description: Delete transcript chunks after a configurable number of days and keep only the encounter summary and action items.

title: Privacy features from the plan
description: PLAN.md §10 items that aren't built yet.

title: Forget this person
description: A CLI command, API endpoint and button on the card that delete the person's node and all their facts, encounters, notes and action items.

title: Impeccable document: DESIGN.md from the current styles
description: Run `/impeccable document` to record the existing visual system in web/styles.css as DESIGN.md.

title: Import Granola transcripts into the recap
description: Phase 1 path from the plan: pull Granola meetings, match them to encounters by time and names, extract action items. Today this only works by hand through the Granola MCP server (docs/PHASE0.md).

title: History across events
description: Phase 3: 'You met her at NeurIPS last year.'

title: Export action items to Reminders and people to Obsidian
description: Phase 3 in the plan.
